name: EvoCodeBench
description: EvoCodeBench is an evolving benchmark for code generation aligned with real-world code repositories. It includes comprehensive annotations and robust evaluation metrics, and is automatically updated to avoid data leakage, enabling evaluation of LLMs' coding abilities in realistic repository contexts.
reputation: A recent benchmark aimed at realistic repository-level code generation, with growing interest for leakage-aware evaluation of coding models.
notes: Evolving benchmark updated from latest repositories; includes repository-level code generation tasks.
